name: io.github.Byggarepop/tokensaver
title: TokenSaver
description: A structural warm start for AI coding agents in .NET — a cheap Roslyn signature map of C#/Razor/.NET files so the model reads only what it needs. Biggest win on smaller/cheaper models and large files.

environmentVariables.name: TOKENSAVER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the TokenSaver reporting dashboard. Defaults to https://tokensavermcp.com.

environmentVariables.name: TOKENSAVER_NO_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to opt out of anonymous usage telemetry.
